title: I built a daily puzzle game where you meld minds with AI
author: Cwackerfuss
selftext:
In case y'all were wondering, I'm using BAML with OpenRouter to quickly test and eval different models. I settled on Gemini 2.0 Flash as the best balance of cost, quality, and speed.

[Play Converge](https://convergegame.com)

  
If you like it, share your results below!

comments.author: oniris
comments.body: It's good. But 13hrs to the next converge? That is cruel.

replies.author: Cwackerfuss
replies.body:
Hahah fair enough - I love daily games (I play NYT and LinkedIn games daily) but maybe you have point.

Can I ask - would you prefer to just be able to replay with the same AI starting word as many times as you want, or would you want the AI to pick a unique word on every play?

replies.author: oniris
replies.body:
Hehe, I'm more of an RPG, MMORPG + Wargames kind of guy. So maybe my perspective is biased, other people may actually be excited about the episodic nature of things.

Definitely a unique word on every play, for me. I wouldn't ever replay the same word.

replies.author: TbanksIV
replies.body:
I think having the version you have right now as a 'play however much you want' version is cool.

But to make a NYT type daily 'dle' esque thing there should be a diff approach.

Maybe have the AI's word change every day and then the user has to pick a word where they think they can guess the converge word, and then the user puts in the guess between their first word and the aI's first word then let it go from there.

That way the challenge changes every day in some meaningful way, but you can still play the current way whenever.

comments.author: lonelanta
comments.body: Got it in 6! I don't fully understand how the AI adapts just yet, but I'm interested to keep playing. I'd definitely be interested in playing a backlog of connections, like how you can play past wordles in the NYT app.

replies.author: Cwackerfuss
replies.body: awesome that's great feedback - thank you!! I'll build that out next.

comments.author: OOPSStudio
comments.body:
1. point
2. data
3. algorithm
4. search
5. optimization
6. routing
7. management
8. governance

I don't see any way I was supposed to be able to predict the next word in this sequence... This felt like a roll of the dice. Going from point to data is impossible to anticipate. Going from data to algorithm is very hard, algorithm to search is very hard, search to optimization is bordering on impossible, optimization to routing is impossible, routing to management is very hard, and management to governance wouldn't be too difficult except that "governance" has zero relation to any of the prior words other than "management".

It seems like the AI is just throwing out random words that have a similar vibe, of which there are at least 50+ more closely-related options and I see no reason why I would assume the AI would pick that specific one.

replies.author: Cwackerfuss
replies.body: If you replay tomorrow (or go incognito and play again), you might have better luck after re-reading the instructions. The game is not to guess what the AI will say next in the sequence, it’s to guess the same word based on association between your word and AIs word. So for Fire + Water, you may both guess “Steam”
